BusinessContext.Description: Converts interbank payment message (MT202) to securities settlement instruction (MT500). Used in collateral management and treasury operations when cash payments need to be linked with securities transactions.

UseCases.UseCase: Treasury Operations - Payment vs. Securities delivery

Variable.name: MAX_REFERENCE_LENGTH
Variable.description: Maximum length of MT202 and MT500 reference fields (field 20, 21)

Variable.name: MAX_NARRATIVE_LENGTH
Variable.description: Maximum characters for MT500 field 70E narrative

Variable.name: MAX_DECIMAL_PLACES
Variable.description: Maximum decimal places for settlement amount

Variable.name: CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR
Variable.description: 2-digit year >= this treated as 20xx, below as 21xx

Variable.name: T_PLUS_STANDARD
Variable.description: Standard settlement cycle in business days (T+2)

Variable.name: T_PLUS_MAX_WARNING
Variable.description: Settlement days beyond which a warning is raised

Variable.name: DEFAULT_SETTLEMENT_SYSTEM
Variable.description: Default CSD/ICSD BIC (Euroclear) when no currency map found

Variable.name: ISIN_LENGTH
Variable.description: Fixed length of a valid ISIN code

Variable.name: SECURITY_CACHE_TTL_HOURS
Variable.description: Security reference data cache time-to-live in hours

Variable.name: BIC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS
Variable.description: BIC directory cache time-to-live in hours

Variable.name: SANCTIONS_SCREENING_ENABLED
Variable.description: Whether real-time sanctions screening is active

Variable.name: MIFID_APPROVED_LIST_CHECK
Variable.description: Whether security must be on MiFID II approved trading list

Variable.name: AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS
Variable.description: Regulatory minimum audit log retention period in years

Variable.name: SETTLEMENT_SYSTEM_MAP
Variable.description: Currency to CSD/ICSD BIC mapping table

Variable.name: PROCESSING_TIMEZONE
Variable.description: All timestamps generated in this timezone

Field.Description: Sender's reference for the transaction

ValidationRules.Rule: Must be unique within sender's system

Field.Description: Reference to the related transaction

ValidationRules.Rule: References previous message in the chain

Field.Description: Settlement date, currency and amount

ValidationRules.Rule: Date must be valid business day
Currency must be valid ISO 4217 code

Field.Description: BIC of the institution that orders the transfer

ValidationRules.Rule: Must be valid BIC format (8 or 11 characters)

Field.Description: Name and address of ordering institution - used when BIC not available
Field.ExampleValue: BARCLAYS BANK PLC LONDON UNITED KINGDOM

Field.Description: BIC of sender's correspondent bank
BIC of receiver's correspondent bank
BIC of intermediary bank in the payment chain
BIC of institution where account is held
BIC of the final beneficiary institution
Additional information between sender and receiver - contains security ISIN via /INS/ code
Unique reference assigned by sender - copied from MT202 field 20
Reference to previous related message - copied from MT202 field 21
Indicates the function of the message - always NEWM for MT202 to MT500 conversion
ISIN and description of the security being settled - extracted from MT202 field 72 /INS/ code
Date on which settlement is due - converted from MT202 YYMMDD to YYYYMMDD
Cash amount to be settled for the securities transaction
Party that purchases the securities - mapped from MT202 ordering institution
Party that sells the securities - mapped from MT202 beneficiary institution
CSD/ICSD where settlement takes place - derived from payment currency
Custodian delivering the securities - mapped from MT202 account with institution
Narrative linking MT500 to originating MT202 payment reference
Field.ExampleValue: LINKED TO PAYMENT MT202 REF BNKREF2026020301

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Missing transaction reference"
TRUNCATE to MAX_REFERENCE_LENGTH characters
REJECT with error "Invalid reference format - must be uppercase alphanumeric"

General.ImpactIfFails: MT500 cannot be processed. Traceability link between payment and securities settlement broken.
General.BusinessRationale: Transaction reference ensures end-to-end traceability between the cash leg (MT202) and securities leg (MT500). Critical for DVP reconciliation, failed trade investigation, and collateral management audit trail.
General.PerformanceImpact: NEGLIGIBLE (direct string copy with format validation)
General.AuditRequirement: Reference logged with both MT202 and MT500 messages for cross-message audit trail. Required for EMIR trade repository reporting and MiFID II transaction reporting. Retained AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Unique reference required per SWIFT ISO 15022 MT500 standards. Enables EMIR reporting linkage between cash and securities legs of same transaction. MiFID II Article 26 transaction reporting requires unique trade identifier.
General.DataPrivacy: Transaction reference is operational identifier. No direct PII. BIC codes embedded in reference are public identifiers. No GDPR special handling required.
General.MigrationNote: Clean 1:1 copy from MT202 field 20 to MT500 field 20C SEME. No format transformation needed - both fields share same 16-char alphanumeric constraint. Uppercase enforcement applied as MT500 is stricter than MT202 on character case.
General.CachingStrategy: No caching - direct copy. Reference uniqueness validation done against in-memory set of processed references per session.

Condition.ElseAction: SET_TO_EMPTY - field is optional in MT500
TRUNCATE to MAX_REFERENCE_LENGTH characters

General.ImpactIfFails: Loss of previous message link in transaction chain. Audit trail less complete but MT500 remains processable.
General.BusinessRationale: Preserves the chain of related messages in multi-leg securities transactions. Enables investigation teams to trace back through the full transaction lifecycle from initial instruction to final settlement.
General.AuditRequirement: Previous reference logged when present. Chain of related references enables reconstruction of full transaction history for regulatory investigation.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Related reference supports EMIR reporting requirement for trade lifecycle event linkage. Allows linking amendment, cancellation, or replacement messages to original instruction.
General.DataPrivacy: Reference is operational identifier. No PII. No GDPR restrictions.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 field 21 (Related Reference) maps to MT500 field 20C PREV qualifier. Both use same 16-char alphanumeric format. Optional in both source and target.
General.CachingStrategy: No caching required - direct copy or empty.

MappingFormula.Expression: currency = extract_currency(source.field_32A, position 7-9) amount = extract_amount(source.field_32A, position 10+) target.field_19A_SETT = format("{currency}{amount}", currency, amount)
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: full_field = source.field_32A date_part = substring(full_field, 1, 6) currency_part = substring(full_field, 7, 3) amount_part = substring(full_field, 10) target_amount = currency_part + amount_part return target_amount

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Missing amount information in field 32A"
REJECT with error "Invalid field 32A format - expected YYMMDDCCCNNNNN,NN"
REJECT with error "Settlement amount must be strictly positive"
REJECT with error "Invalid or unsupported currency code"

General.ImpactIfFails: Securities settlement cannot be executed. DVP (Delivery versus Payment) cash leg missing. Risk of securities delivery without payment (free delivery).
General.BusinessRationale: Cash amount is the core of the DVP settlement. Must match the securities market value exactly. Any discrepancy causes settlement failure and potential loss. Used by CSD/ICSD to match cash leg against securities leg.
General.PerformanceImpact: LOW (string parsing and extraction - fully in-memory)
General.AuditRequirement: Settlement amount logged with transaction reference for SOX financial controls. All amount extractions logged with before/after values. Required for EMIR trade repository reporting. Retained AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Accurate settlement amount required for EMIR reporting of securities financing transactions. CSDR Settlement Discipline requires accurate DVP amounts to prevent settlement fails. SOX requires auditable amount transformation with zero tolerance for errors.
General.DataPrivacy: Settlement amounts are financial transaction data. Not PII per GDPR but sensitive financial information. Access restricted to treasury and securities operations teams.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 field 32A is composite (YYMMDD + CCY + AMOUNT). MT500 field 19A uses CCY + AMOUNT format only (date handled separately in MAPPING_04). Decimal separator preserved as comma per SWIFT ISO 15022 convention for both messages - no format conversion needed.
General.CachingStrategy: No caching - amount extracted directly from each message.

MappingFormula.Expression: value_date_yy = extract_date(source.field_32A, position 1-6) century = determine_century(value_date_yy) target.field_98A_SETT = format_date_yyyymmdd(century + value_date_yy)
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: date_string = substring(source.field_32A, 1, 6) year_2digit = substring(date_string, 1, 2) month = substring(date_string, 3, 2) day = substring(date_string, 5, 2) if (year_2digit >= CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR) then century = "20" else century = "21" endif target_date = century + year_2digit + month + day return target_date

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Invalid settlement date in field 32A"
REJECT with error "Settlement date cannot be in the past"
LOG_WARNING "Settlement date exceeds T+ T_PLUS_MAX_WARNING standard cycle"
ADJUST to next business day AND LOG warning per market convention

General.ImpactIfFails: Wrong settlement date causes DVP mismatch. Securities and cash legs settle on different dates creating delivery risk. CSDR Settlement Discipline penalty triggered for late settlement.
General.BusinessRationale: Settlement date must align cash and securities legs exactly for DVP to work. Standard T_PLUS_STANDARD cycle ensures securities and cash settle simultaneously. Business day adjustment per market convention prevents settlement on non-trading days.
General.PerformanceImpact: MEDIUM (date conversion + business calendar lookup from in-memory cache)
General.AuditRequirement: Settlement date logged with transaction. Any business day adjustments logged with original and adjusted dates. CSDR requires settlement date accuracy for discipline regime calculations. Retained AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: CSDR Settlement Discipline Regulation (EU 909/2014) requires settlement on intended settlement date. Late settlement triggers automatic cash penalty. Standard cycle is T_PLUS_STANDARD business days per EU regulation. Business day determined per settlement market calendar.
General.DataPrivacy: Settlement date is operational data. No PII. No GDPR restrictions.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 uses YYMMDD format in composite field 32A. MT500 field 98A uses YYYYMMDD. Century determination uses CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR: year >= cutoff is 20xx else 21xx. Same logic as MT940 YYMMDD conversion.
General.CachingStrategy: Market business day calendars cached per currency and market at startup. Refreshed annually and on ad-hoc holiday announcements from market infrastructure providers.

MappingFormula.Expression: IF source.field_52A != null THEN target.field_95P_BUYR = source.field_52A ELSE IF source.field_52D != null THEN target.field_95P_BUYR = lookup_bic_from_name(source.field_52D) ELSE target.field_95P_BUYR = get_default_buyer_from_config() ENDIF
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: if (source.field_52A is not null) then buyer_bic = source.field_52A else if (source.field_52D is not null) then institution_name = source.field_52D buyer_bic = reference_data_service.lookup_bic(institution_name) if (buyer_bic is null) then throw error "Cannot resolve BIC from institution name in field 52D" endif else buyer_bic = get_sender_bic() endif return buyer_bic

Condition.ElseAction: USE_DEFAULT from sender BIC in message header
REJECT if format invalid AND no 52D fallback available
LOG_WARNING "BIC not found in SWIFT directory" AND PROCEED
BLOCK message AND ALERT compliance team immediately

General.ImpactIfFails: Securities delivered to wrong buyer. Ownership transfer incorrectly recorded. Potential for securities loss and major operational risk requiring costly recovery.
General.BusinessRationale: Buyer identification is critical for correct securities ownership transfer. Wrong buyer = wrong settlement. Name-to-BIC lookup from field 52D required when BIC not directly provided. Sanctions screening mandatory before any securities delivery instruction.
General.PerformanceImpact: MEDIUM (BIC directory lookup from BIC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS-hour cache + sanctions check ~50-100ms)
General.AuditRequirement: Buyer BIC logged with settlement instruction. Sanctions screening result and list version logged per AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years. BIC resolution method (direct vs name lookup) logged for audit transparency.
General.ComplianceRequirement: KYC verification of buyer required per AML regulations before securities delivery. Sanctions screening mandatory per OFAC, EU, and UN consolidated lists. MiFID II Article 26 requires counterparty identification for transaction reporting.
General.DataPrivacy: BIC codes are public institutional identifiers. Not PII under GDPR. Institution names in field 52D may be confidential commercial information but not personal data.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 has two options for ordering institution: field 52A (BIC) and field 52D (Name and Address). MT500 field 95P BUYR requires BIC. When only 52D available, BIC must be resolved via reference data service lookup. Fallback to sender BIC when both absent.
General.CachingStrategy: BIC directory cached for BIC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS hours. Name-to-BIC mapping cached for 4 hours (less stable than BIC directory). Sanctions list cached with 4-hour refresh. Individual screening results not cached.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: seller_bic = source.field_58A if (NOT is_valid_bic(seller_bic)) then throw error "Invalid seller BIC format" endif if (is_sanctioned(seller_bic)) then throw error "Seller is on sanctions list - transaction blocked" endif if (NOT is_eligible_for_securities_settlement(seller_bic)) then throw error "Entity not eligible for securities settlement" endif return seller_bic

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Missing beneficiary institution field 58A"
REJECT with error "Invalid BIC format in field 58A"
BLOCK message AND ALERT compliance team immediately
REJECT with error "Entity not eligible for securities settlement at target CSD"

General.ImpactIfFails: Cash payment directed to wrong seller. Securities ownership not correctly transferred. Financial loss and potential regulatory breach for failing to identify correct counterparty.
General.BusinessRationale: Seller must be the current owner of the securities to be delivered. Eligibility check ensures seller has account at target CSD and is authorized for securities transactions. Sanctions check prevents facilitating transactions with sanctioned entities.
General.PerformanceImpact: MEDIUM (sanctions check + eligibility check - ~50-100ms from cached data)
General.AuditRequirement: Seller BIC, sanctions screening result, and eligibility check result logged per transaction. Required for EMIR counterparty reporting and MiFID II transaction reporting. Retained AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: OFAC and EU sanctions screening mandatory. Eligibility check required by CSD rules - only members or participants can settle at a given CSD. MiFID II requires counterparty LEI or BIC for transaction reporting Article 26.
General.DataPrivacy: BIC is public institutional identifier. Not PII. Eligibility status is institutional data, not personal data. No GDPR restrictions.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 field 58A (Beneficiary Institution) maps semantically to MT500 field 95P SELL. In a securities DVP transaction, the MT202 beneficiary receives the cash, which means they are selling securities and receiving payment. Clear semantic role reversal from payment perspective to securities perspective.
General.CachingStrategy: CSD eligibility data cached per institution BIC and target CSD. Refreshed weekly. Sanctions screening not cached per institution.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: currency = extract_currency_from_field_32A() settlement_map = { "USD": "DTCYUS33XXX", "EUR": "CEDELULLXXX", "GBP": "CRSTGB2LXXX", "JPY": "JSDCJPJTXXX" } if (settlement_map.contains(currency)) then settlement_bic = settlement_map[currency] else settlement_bic = DEFAULT_SETTLEMENT_SYSTEM endif return settlement_bic

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Cannot determine settlement system - currency missing"
USE_DEFAULT_SYSTEM (DEFAULT_SETTLEMENT_SYSTEM) AND LOG warning
REJECT with error "No connectivity to required settlement system"

General.ImpactIfFails: Settlement instruction routed to wrong CSD/ICSD. Settlement fails or delayed. DVP fails. Potential for partial settlement (one leg settles, other does not).
General.BusinessRationale: Different currencies settle in different market infrastructures (CSD/ICSDs). USD securities settle at DTC (US), EUR at Clearstream Luxembourg or Euroclear, GBP at CREST (UK), JPY at JASDEC (Japan). Correct routing is mandatory for settlement success.
General.PerformanceImpact: LOW (in-memory map lookup from SETTLEMENT_SYSTEM_MAP configuration)
General.AuditRequirement: Settlement system derivation logged with currency input and system output. Connectivity check result logged. Required for CSDR settlement discipline reporting. Retained AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: CSDR requires settlement at authorized CSD for the security type. Routing to correct CSD ensures compliance with settlement finality rules per Directive 98/26/EC. MiFID II requires settlement venue identification in transaction reports.
General.DataPrivacy: Currency and settlement system BIC are operational data. No PII. No GDPR restrictions.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 does not contain settlement system information - it must be derived from the payment currency. The SETTLEMENT_SYSTEM_MAP configuration must be maintained and kept current as market infrastructure evolves (e.g. T2S harmonization of EUR settlement).
General.CachingStrategy: SETTLEMENT_SYSTEM_MAP loaded from configuration at startup and cached in memory. Connectivity status to each CSD cached with 1-minute TTL. Cache refreshed on reconnection events.

Condition.ElseAction: N/A - always new message for MT202 to MT500 conversion

Variable.name: MT500_DEFAULT_FUNCTION
Variable.description: Default MT500 message function for MT202 to MT500 conversion - always new message

General.ImpactIfFails: MT500 rejected by receiving CSD or custodian - field 23G is mandatory in MT500 schema.
General.BusinessRationale: MT500 requires explicit message function code to distinguish new instructions from cancellations (CANC) or replacements (REPL). MT202 conversion always generates new settlement instructions. Cancellation flow requires separate process using MT500 with CANC function.
General.AuditRequirement: Message function logged with settlement instruction. Any deviation from NEWM (e.g. manual override to CANC) requires supervisor approval and separate audit record.
General.ComplianceRequirement: ISO 15022 MT500 schema validation requires field 23G with valid code. NEWM is correct for new instruction flow. CANC requires separate authorization per securities operations procedures.
General.DataPrivacy: Message function code is operational data. No PII. No GDPR restrictions.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 has no equivalent function code field - it is always a new payment instruction. MT500 adds this explicit classification. If cancellation flow is needed, MT202 cancellation (MT299 or MT195) triggers MT500 with CANC function through a separate conversion path not covered by this mapping.

MappingFormula.Expression: IF contains(source.field_72, '/INS/') THEN isin = extract_after(source.field_72, '/INS/') security_details = reference_data_service.get_security(isin) target.field_35B = format_security(isin, security_details) ELSE REJECT with error "No security identifier found in field 72" ENDIF
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_72_content = source.field_72 if (field_72_content contains "/INS/") then start_pos = position_of("/INS/") + 5 isin_code = substring(field_72_content, start_pos, ISIN_LENGTH) security = reference_data_service.lookup(isin_code) if (security found) then security_description = "ISIN " + isin_code + "\n" + security.name else log_warning("Security not found in reference data - using ISIN only") security_description = "ISIN " + isin_code endif else throw error "No /INS/ security identifier in field 72" endif return security_description

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Missing /INS/ security identifier in field 72"
REJECT with error "Invalid ISIN format - must be 12 alphanumeric characters"

Condition.Action: ENRICH with security name and description
Condition.ElseAction: LOG_WARNING "Security not in reference data" AND USE_ISIN_ONLY
REJECT with error "Security not eligible for settlement or not on MiFID II approved list"

General.ImpactIfFails: Wrong security settled. Catastrophic operational risk - delivers different security than intended. Requires costly recovery including potential buy-in proceedings.
General.BusinessRationale: ISIN is the universal identifier for the security being transferred. Any error in security identification results in wrong asset delivery. Reference data enrichment adds security name for CSD matching and human verification. MiFID II eligibility check prevents settlement of non-authorized instruments.
General.PerformanceImpact: HIGH (reference data lookup with SECURITY_CACHE_TTL_HOURS-hour cache - ~50ms cached, ~200ms uncached)
General.AuditRequirement: ISIN, security name, and eligibility check result logged per settlement instruction. MIFID II approved list version logged for regulatory traceability. Required for EMIR securities financing transaction reporting. Retained AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: MiFID II requires ISIN for transaction reporting Article 26. EMIR requires security identifier for securities financing transaction reporting. MIFID_APPROVED_LIST_CHECK ensures only authorized instruments are settled. CSDR requires valid ISIN for settlement instruction matching.
General.DataPrivacy: ISIN and security names are public market data. Not PII. Not subject to GDPR restrictions. Security reference data may be commercially sensitive (pricing) but not personal.
General.MigrationNote: Security identifier embedded in MT202 field 72 using /INS/ structured code - this is a convention, not a standard MT202 field. Extraction requires parsing free-text field 72. ISIN extracted at position after /INS/ for exactly ISIN_LENGTH characters. Security enrichment from reference data system improves MT500 field 35B readability for CSD matching.
General.CachingStrategy: Security reference data cached per ISIN with SECURITY_CACHE_TTL_HOURS-hour TTL. Cache reduces reference data service load for frequently traded securities. Cache miss triggers synchronous lookup. MiFID approved list cached with 24-hour refresh.

MappingFormula.Expression: IF source.field_57A != null THEN target.field_95P_DEAG = source.field_57A ELSE IF source.field_56A != null THEN target.field_95P_DEAG = source.field_56A ELSE target.field_95P_DEAG = get_default_delivering_agent() ENDIF
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: if (source.field_57A is not null) then delivering_agent = source.field_57A else if (source.field_56A is not null) then delivering_agent = source.field_56A else buyer_bic = already_mapped_buyer delivering_agent = lookup_default_custodian(buyer_bic) endif return delivering_agent

Condition.ElseAction: DERIVE_FROM_BUYER default custodian
REJECT with error "Invalid delivering agent BIC"
LOG_WARNING "Delivering agent has no known relationship with buyer - verify manually"

General.ImpactIfFails: Securities delivery routing ambiguous. Settlement may be delayed or misrouted at CSD. Custodian cannot match delivery instruction to expected receipt.
General.BusinessRationale: Delivering agent identifies the custodian holding and delivering the securities. Without it, CSD cannot route the delivery to correct participant account. Fallback to buyer default custodian ensures settlement can proceed even when field absent.
General.PerformanceImpact: MEDIUM (conditional logic + custodian relationship lookup from BIC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS-hour cache)
General.AuditRequirement: Delivering agent BIC and derivation method logged per settlement instruction. Relationship warning flags logged for manual review. Required for custodian reconciliation audit. Retained AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Correct custodian identification required for CSDR settlement matching at CSD. Unmatched deliveries trigger CSDR buy-in proceedings. Agent eligibility as CSD participant verified.
General.DataPrivacy: Custodian BIC is public institutional identifier. Not PII. No GDPR restrictions.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 field 57A (Account With Institution) takes priority over field 56A (Intermediary) as delivering agent. Field 57A is closer to the actual securities holding account. When both absent, buyer default custodian derived from pre-configured custodian relationship table.
General.CachingStrategy: Custodian-to-buyer relationship table cached at startup. BIC directory cached for BIC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS hours. Default custodian per buyer BIC cached in configuration.

MappingFormula.Expression: original_narrative = source.field_72 reference_link = "LINKED TO PAYMENT " + source.field_20 target.field_70E_SPRO = concatenate(reference_link, original_narrative)
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: payment_ref = source.field_20 original_info = source.field_72 narrative = "LINKED TO PAYMENT MT202 REF " + payment_ref if (original_info is not null) then narrative = narrative + "\n" + original_info endif if (length(narrative) > MAX_NARRATIVE_LENGTH) then narrative = substring(narrative, 1, MAX_NARRATIVE_LENGTH) endif return narrative

Condition.ElseAction: TRUNCATE to MAX_NARRATIVE_LENGTH characters AND LOG truncation
REMOVE_FORBIDDEN_CHARS AND LOG sanitization event

General.ImpactIfFails: Loss of payment-to-settlement link in narrative. MT500 processable but manual reconciliation between cash and securities legs becomes harder. Investigation effort increases.
General.BusinessRationale: Narrative field creates human-readable link between MT500 settlement instruction and originating MT202 payment. Critical for operations teams during settlement fails, reconciliation, and dispute resolution. High audit value despite low criticality for processing.
General.AuditRequirement: Narrative content logged with settlement instruction. Provides human-readable audit trail linking payment reference to securities settlement. Particularly valuable for regulatory investigation teams. Retained AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Narrative supports EMIR reconciliation between cash and securities legs of financing transactions. No specific regulatory requirement for narrative content but recommended by SWIFT best practice guidelines for MT500.
General.DataPrivacy: Narrative may contain institutional references but no personal data. Not PII. No GDPR restrictions. Original field 72 content may reference security names which are public market data.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 field 72 contains free-text information including the /INS/ ISIN code used in MAPPING_09. The narrative preserves the full field 72 content plus adds the MT202 payment reference link. Truncation to MAX_NARRATIVE_LENGTH characters applied when combined narrative exceeds MT500 field limit.
General.CachingStrategy: No caching - pure string transformation per message.
